examples.en: The farmer loaded the hay onto the old wooden wagon.
examples.zh: 农夫把干草装上了那辆旧木头马车。

examples.en: We watched a movie and had dinner afterward.
examples.zh: 我们看了场电影，然后吃了晚饭。

examples.en: The fireworks show was truly spectacular last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚的烟花表演真是壮观。

examples.en: Heavy rain can ruin the whole picnic in minutes.
examples.zh: 大雨几分钟内就能毁掉整个野餐。

examples.en: We won the game by sheer luck.
examples.zh: 我们纯粹是靠运气赢得了比赛。

examples.en: After the illness, she became immune to that virus.
examples.zh: 生病之后，她对那种病毒产生了免疫力。

examples.en: He made an ass of himself at the party.
examples.zh: 他在聚会上出尽了洋相，像个傻瓜。

examples.en: Customers trust the car for its proven reliability.
examples.zh: 顾客信赖这款车，因为它的可靠性已得到证明。

examples.en: She parked her bike alongside the wall.
examples.zh: 她把自行车停在了墙边。

examples.en: The market sells many exotic fruits from Asia.
examples.zh: 这个市场出售许多来自亚洲的异国水果。

examples.en: The angry bull charged across the green field.
examples.zh: 那头愤怒的公牛冲过了绿色的田野。

examples.en: She used a clip to hold the papers together.
examples.zh: 她用一个夹子把这些文件夹在一起。

examples.en: The runner hurt his left thigh during the race.
examples.zh: 那名跑者在比赛中弄伤了左大腿。

examples.en: The farmer keeps many sheep on the green hill.
examples.zh: 那位农夫在绿色的山坡上养了许多羊。

examples.en: Don't let one failure discourage you from trying again.
examples.zh: 不要让一次失败使你气馁而不敢再试。

examples.en: She put the letters in the top drawer.
examples.zh: 她把信放进了最上面的抽屉里。

examples.en: The runner crossed the finish line first.
examples.zh: 那名赛跑者第一个冲过了终点线。

examples.en: The event coordinator made sure everything ran smoothly.
examples.zh: 活动协调员确保一切顺利进行。

examples.en: The two parties have a deep ideological difference.
examples.zh: 这两个政党在意识形态上有着深刻的分歧。

examples.en: They had an intimate dinner at a quiet restaurant.
examples.zh: 他们在一家安静的餐厅吃了一顿亲密的晚餐。

examples.en: The Roman empire once ruled most of Europe.
examples.zh: 罗马帝国曾经统治着欧洲的大部分地区。

examples.en: Public schools should provide a secular education.
examples.zh: 公立学校应该提供世俗的教育。

examples.en: We took a cab to the airport this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我们坐出租车去了机场。

examples.en: We watched a documentary about wild animals last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我们看了一部关于野生动物的纪录片。

examples.en: Switzerland stayed neutral during the war.
examples.zh: 在那场战争中，瑞士保持中立。

examples.en: I studied all night for the math exam.
examples.zh: 我熬了一整夜准备数学考试。

examples.en: The meat was so tender that it melted in my mouth.
examples.zh: 这肉非常嫩，在我嘴里都化开了。

examples.en: She loves biology because she enjoys studying plants.
examples.zh: 她喜欢生物学，因为她喜欢研究植物。

examples.en: The city adopted a progressive new education policy.
examples.zh: 这座城市采用了一项进步的新教育政策。

examples.en: The police uncovered a conspiracy to rob the bank.
examples.zh: 警方揭露了一起抢劫银行的阴谋。

examples.en: Luckily, the accident caused no casualty.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，这起事故没有造成人员伤亡。

examples.en: A huge whale jumped out of the blue sea.
examples.zh: 一头巨大的鲸鱼跃出了蔚蓝的大海。

examples.en: The kitchen is small but fully functional.
examples.zh: 这个厨房虽小，但功能齐全。

examples.en: The prisoner waited for his execution at dawn.
examples.zh: 那名囚犯等待着黎明时分对他的死刑执行。

examples.en: You did a terrific job on the project!
examples.zh: 你在这个项目上做得非常出色！

examples.en: He passed the ball to his teammate quickly.
examples.zh: 他迅速把球传给了队友。

examples.en: Animals follow their instinct to find food.
examples.zh: 动物凭本能去寻找食物。

examples.en: Whoever finishes first can leave the room.
examples.zh: 谁先完成谁就可以离开房间。

examples.en: The can is made of light aluminum.
examples.zh: 这个罐子是用轻便的铝制成的。

examples.en: The Ministry of Education announced a new plan.
examples.zh: 教育部宣布了一项新计划。

examples.en: The teacher will instruct you how to use the machine.
examples.zh: 老师会指导你如何使用这台机器。

examples.en: The helmet protects your skull from injury.
examples.zh: 头盔能保护你的头骨免受伤害。

examples.en: The jury reached a verdict after two hours.
examples.zh: 陪审团在两小时后作出了裁决。

examples.en: A busy bee flew from flower to flower.
examples.zh: 一只忙碌的蜜蜂在花丛间飞来飞去。

examples.en: He tried to manipulate his friends to get money.
examples.zh: 他试图操纵朋友们来弄到钱。

examples.en: The students were friendly and cooperative in class.
examples.zh: 学生们在课堂上友好且乐于合作。

examples.en: She is a skilled practitioner of Chinese medicine.
examples.zh: 她是一位熟练的中医从业者。

examples.en: The government gives a subsidy to poor farmers.
examples.zh: 政府向贫困的农民发放补助金。

examples.en: Please edit the report before you send it.
examples.zh: 请在发送之前编辑一下这份报告。

examples.en: The driver used a whip to make the horse run.
examples.zh: 车夫用鞭子让马跑起来。

examples.en: The children solved the puzzle in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 孩子们在十分钟内解开了这个难题。

examples.en: We picked fresh mushroom in the forest.
examples.zh: 我们在森林里采到了新鲜的蘑菇。

examples.en: Mathematics is my favorite subject at school.
examples.zh: 数学是我在学校最喜欢的科目。

examples.en: Please boil the water before you drink it.
examples.zh: 喝水之前请先把水烧开。

examples.en: It was a tragic accident that killed three people.
examples.zh: 那是一起夺去三人性命的悲惨事故。

examples.en: The mechanic fixed my car in an hour.
examples.zh: 技工一小时内就修好了我的车。

examples.en: The earthquake destroyed many old houses.
examples.zh: 地震摧毁了许多老房子。

examples.en: She kept the cookies in a glass jar.
examples.zh: 她把饼干放在一个玻璃罐里。

examples.en: We should utilize our time wisely every day.
examples.zh: 我们每天都应该明智地利用时间。

examples.en: The plane landed safely despite the storm.
examples.zh: 尽管有暴风雨，飞机还是安全降落了。

examples.en: We had fried rice with pork for lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭我们吃了猪肉炒饭。

examples.en: Art classes help develop a child's creativity.
examples.zh: 美术课有助于培养孩子的创造力。

examples.en: We had ice cream for dessert after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后我们吃了冰淇淋作为甜点。

examples.en: She felt deep sympathy for the homeless children.
examples.zh: 她对那些无家可归的孩子深表同情。

examples.en: The test was incredibly difficult this year.
examples.zh: 今年的考试难得令人难以置信。

examples.en: The old fisherman caught a big fish today.
examples.zh: 那位老渔夫今天钓到了一条大鱼。

examples.en: There are eleven players on a football team.
examples.zh: 一支足球队有十一名球员。

examples.en: Living in isolation made him feel very lonely.
examples.zh: 孤立地生活让他感到非常孤独。

examples.en: I cannot find the other sock anywhere.
examples.zh: 我到处都找不到另一只袜子。

examples.en: She wore a sexy red dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿着一条性感的红裙子去参加派对。

examples.en: The young entrepreneur started her own company.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的企业家创办了自己的公司。

examples.en: Doctors are studying this rare syndrome carefully.
examples.zh: 医生们正在仔细研究这种罕见的综合征。

examples.en: Safety in the workplace is very important.
examples.zh: 工作场所的安全非常重要。

examples.en: Her ambition is to become a famous doctor.
examples.zh: 她的志向是成为一名著名的医生。

examples.en: A cool breeze blew gently across the beach.
examples.zh: 一阵凉爽的微风轻轻吹过海滩。

examples.en: He scored a touchdown in the final minute.
examples.zh: 他在最后一分钟达阵得分。

examples.en: Buying a house in the city is very costly.
examples.zh: 在城里买房非常昂贵。

examples.en: He is an ambitious young man with big plans.
examples.zh: 他是个雄心勃勃、抱负远大的年轻人。

examples.en: He is late, presumably because of the traffic.
examples.zh: 他迟到了，大概是因为交通堵塞。

examples.en: She is one of the most influential writers today.
examples.zh: 她是当今最有影响力的作家之一。

examples.en: I read an English translation of the Chinese novel.
examples.zh: 我读了那本中文小说的英文译本。

examples.en: I am uncertain about which job to choose.
examples.zh: 我对该选择哪份工作还不确定。

examples.en: The report includes a lot of statistical data.
examples.zh: 这份报告包含了大量统计数据。

examples.en: She lives in a busy metropolitan area.
examples.zh: 她住在一个繁忙的大都市区。

examples.en: Sugar will dissolve quickly in hot water.
examples.zh: 糖在热水中会很快溶解。

examples.en: The building has great aesthetic value.
examples.zh: 这座建筑具有很高的美学价值。

examples.en: My gut told me something was wrong.
examples.zh: 我的直觉告诉我有些不对劲。

examples.en: Can you spell your last name for me?
examples.zh: 你能为我拼写一下你的姓吗？

examples.en: We sat in a corner booth at the cafe.
examples.zh: 我们坐在咖啡馆角落的卡座里。

examples.en: Please insert your card into the machine.
examples.zh: 请把你的卡插入机器里。

examples.en: Always wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
examples.zh: 骑车时一定要戴头盔。

examples.en: She tied a belt around her waist.
examples.zh: 她在腰间系了一条腰带。

examples.en: The lion is often called the king of animals.
examples.zh: 狮子常被称为动物之王。

examples.en: The royal family lives in a grand palace.
examples.zh: 王室成员住在一座宏伟的宫殿里。

examples.en: She actively takes part in school activities.
examples.zh: 她积极地参加学校的活动。

examples.en: Passing the exam was a great accomplishment for him.
examples.zh: 通过考试对他来说是一项了不起的成就。

examples.en: Don't panic; we still have plenty of time.
examples.zh: 别惊慌，我们还有充足的时间。

examples.en: The machine can crush old cars into metal blocks.
examples.zh: 这台机器能把旧车压碎成金属块。

examples.en: They stood at the top of the steep cliff.
examples.zh: 他们站在陡峭悬崖的顶端。

examples.en: The new plan caused minimal change to our work.
examples.zh: 新计划对我们的工作造成的改变极小。

examples.en: He tied the box with a strong cord.
examples.zh: 他用一根结实的绳子捆住了箱子。

examples.en: The police found cocaine hidden in the car.
examples.zh: 警方发现了藏在车里的可卡因。

examples.en: Fortunately, nobody was hurt in the accident.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，事故中没有人受伤。

examples.en: The magic trick was just a clever illusion.
examples.zh: 那个魔术只是一个巧妙的错觉。

examples.en: The gift came from an anonymous person.
examples.zh: 这份礼物来自一位匿名人士。

examples.en: I cannot tolerate such rude behavior.
examples.zh: 我无法容忍这样无礼的行为。

examples.en: The police commissioner spoke to reporters today.
examples.zh: 警察局长今天向记者发表了讲话。

examples.en: She wrote a letter to show her appreciation.
examples.zh: 她写了一封信来表达她的感激之情。

examples.en: Yoga can improve your body's flexibility.
examples.zh: 瑜伽能提高你身体的柔韧性。

examples.en: The teacher made an instructional video for students.
examples.zh: 老师为学生们制作了一段教学视频。

examples.en: They lost a lot of money at the casino.
examples.zh: 他们在赌场输了很多钱。

examples.en: The kids had to scramble up the rocky hill.
examples.zh: 孩子们不得不攀爬上那座多岩石的小山。

examples.en: We will decorate the room with colorful balloons.
examples.zh: 我们要用五彩的气球装饰这个房间。

examples.en: One dollar is roughly equivalent to seven yuan.
examples.zh: 一美元大约相当于七元人民币。

examples.en: The nurse checked the patient's pulse carefully.
examples.zh: 护士仔细检查了病人的脉搏。

examples.en: She writes in her diary every night.
examples.zh: 她每晚都在日记里写东西。

examples.en: The team gained momentum after the first goal.
examples.zh: 球队在第一个进球后士气大增。

examples.en: He made a generous donation to the school.
examples.zh: 他向学校慷慨地捐了一笔款。

examples.en: She has no sibling, so she is an only child.
examples.zh: 她没有兄弟姐妹，所以是个独生子女。

examples.en: The irony is that the fire station burned down.
examples.zh: 讽刺的是，消防站竟然被烧毁了。

examples.en: He ate the soup with a large spoon.
examples.zh: 他用一把大勺子喝汤。

examples.en: A black cat ran down the narrow alley.
examples.zh: 一只黑猫沿着狭窄的小巷跑了下去。

examples.en: Children learn how to interact with others at school.
examples.zh: 孩子们在学校学习如何与他人交往。

examples.en: She stood quietly in the midst of the crowd.
examples.zh: 她静静地站在人群中间。

examples.en: Wash your hands with soap and water.
examples.zh: 用肥皂和水洗手。

examples.en: The little puppy is so cute and friendly.
examples.zh: 这只小狗又可爱又友善。

examples.en: Our team beat its biggest rival yesterday.
examples.zh: 我们队昨天击败了最大的对手。

examples.en: She used a pin to hold the cloth in place.
examples.zh: 她用一根大头针把布固定住。

examples.en: He gave the bag a hard punch.
examples.zh: 他对着袋子狠狠打了一拳。

examples.en: They play hockey on the field every Sunday.
examples.zh: 他们每个星期天都在场地上打曲棍球。

examples.en: If you persist, you will reach your goal.
examples.zh: 如果你坚持下去，就会实现目标。

examples.en: We found a new supplier for cheaper parts.
examples.zh: 我们找到了一家供应更便宜零件的新供应商。

examples.en: Click the icon to open the program.
examples.zh: 点击这个图标来打开程序。

examples.en: The elephant slowly walked toward the river.
examples.zh: 那头大象慢慢地朝河边走去。

examples.en: He bought a franchise to open a coffee shop.
examples.zh: 他购买了特许经营权来开一家咖啡店。

examples.en: She took some coins out of her purse.
examples.zh: 她从钱包里拿出了一些硬币。

examples.en: Good teachers foster a love of learning in children.
examples.zh: 好老师能培养孩子们对学习的热爱。

examples.en: Water is a liquid at room temperature.
examples.zh: 在室温下，水是一种液体。

examples.en: The state legislature passed a new law today.
examples.zh: 州立法机关今天通过了一项新法律。

examples.en: He missed the bus and consequently was late.
examples.zh: 他没赶上公交车，所以迟到了。

examples.en: She answered every question correctly.
examples.zh: 她正确地回答了每一个问题。

examples.en: He felt mentally tired after the long meeting.
examples.zh: 开完长会后，他感到精神上很疲惫。

examples.en: She rides her bicycle to school every day.
examples.zh: 她每天骑自行车去上学。

examples.en: It is wrong to cheat on an exam.
examples.zh: 考试作弊是不对的。

examples.en: This filter removes dirt from the water.
examples.zh: 这个过滤器能去除水中的脏东西。

examples.en: The wound will heal in a few days.
examples.zh: 这个伤口几天后就会痊愈。

examples.en: The child had a high fever last night.
examples.zh: 这个孩子昨晚发了高烧。

examples.en: The little rabbit hopped across the grass.
examples.zh: 那只小兔子蹦蹦跳跳地穿过草地。

examples.en: Some companies exploit their workers for profit.
examples.zh: 一些公司为了利润而剥削工人。

examples.en: Every living organism needs water to survive.
examples.zh: 每一个生物体都需要水才能生存。

examples.en: He dropped a coin into the wishing well.
examples.zh: 他往许愿井里投了一枚硬币。

examples.en: The library is easily accessible by bus.
examples.zh: 这家图书馆乘公交车很容易到达。

examples.en: The GOP won the election in that state.
examples.zh: 共和党在那个州赢得了选举。

examples.en: I felt a strange sensation in my hand.
examples.zh: 我感到手上有一种奇怪的感觉。

examples.en: The road was partially blocked by snow.
examples.zh: 这条路被雪部分地堵住了。

examples.en: My bedroom is upstairs, next to the bathroom.
examples.zh: 我的卧室在楼上，挨着浴室。

examples.en: He gave the door a hard shove to open it.
examples.zh: 他用力推了一下门把它打开。

examples.en: The town received its charter from the king.
examples.zh: 这座城镇从国王那里获得了特许状。

examples.en: The kids played football in the backyard.
examples.zh: 孩子们在后院踢足球。

examples.en: The two sisters look very much alike.
examples.zh: 这两姐妹长得非常相似。

examples.en: I set a reminder to call my mother.
examples.zh: 我设了一个提醒，提醒自己给妈妈打电话。

examples.en: You need your parents' consent to go on the trip.
examples.zh: 你需要父母的同意才能去旅行。

examples.en: The team comprises ten players and one coach.
examples.zh: 这支队伍由十名队员和一名教练组成。

examples.en: She visits her grandchild every weekend.
examples.zh: 她每个周末都去看望她的孙子。

examples.en: The placement of the sofa makes the room look bigger.
examples.zh: 沙发的摆放位置让房间显得更大了。

examples.en: She rolled the dough flat to make a pizza.
examples.zh: 她把面团擀平来做披萨。

examples.en: Cutting down forests causes serious ecological damage.
examples.zh: 砍伐森林会造成严重的生态破坏。

examples.en: The singer is reportedly moving to a new city.
examples.zh: 据报道，那位歌手将搬到一座新城市。

examples.en: The dam holds back a huge lake of water.
examples.zh: 这座大坝拦住了一个巨大的水库。

examples.en: She wore a new outfit to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一套新衣服去参加聚会。

examples.en: The country faced an unprecedented level of rain.
examples.zh: 这个国家面临着前所未有的降雨量。

examples.en: She works as a columnist for a famous newspaper.
examples.zh: 她是一家著名报纸的专栏作家。

examples.en: I do a quick workout every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上都做一次简短的锻炼。

examples.en: The team won its preliminary match easily.
examples.zh: 这支队伍轻松赢得了预选赛。

examples.en: He got a patent for his new invention.
examples.zh: 他为自己的新发明取得了专利权。

examples.en: She is too shy to speak in front of others.
examples.zh: 她太害羞了，不敢在别人面前讲话。

examples.en: Please take the trash out before you leave.
examples.zh: 离开前请把垃圾拿出去。

examples.en: The company's gross income rose this year.
examples.zh: 公司今年的总收入增长了。

examples.en: She drew the picture with a sharp pencil.
examples.zh: 她用一支削尖的铅笔画了这幅画。

examples.en: The cloth has a soft and smooth texture.
examples.zh: 这块布料的质地柔软光滑。

examples.en: Damn, I forgot my keys at home!
examples.zh: 该死，我把钥匙忘在家里了！

examples.en: Settlers moved west to live on the frontier.
examples.zh: 拓荒者们向西迁移，到边疆去生活。

examples.en: Growth hormone helps children grow taller.
examples.zh: 生长激素帮助孩子长得更高。

examples.en: She used a spray to water the small plants.
examples.zh: 她用喷雾器给小植物浇水。

examples.en: The company refused to disclose its plans.
examples.zh: 这家公司拒绝透露它的计划。

examples.en: Her father is a banker in a big city.
examples.zh: 她的父亲是大城市里的一位银行家。

examples.en: The caller left a message on my phone.
examples.zh: 来电者在我手机上留了言。

examples.en: The suspect is now in police custody.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人现在被警方拘留。

examples.en: An old oak tree stands in front of the house.
examples.zh: 一棵老橡树立在房子前面。

examples.en: Please don't interfere in my private affairs.
examples.zh: 请不要干涉我的私事。

examples.en: Her birthday is on the eighth of May.
examples.zh: 她的生日是五月八号。

examples.en: He wrote the notes in his blue notebook.
examples.zh: 他把笔记记在他的蓝色笔记本里。

examples.en: A wild beast roared in the dark forest.
examples.zh: 一头野兽在黑暗的森林里咆哮。

examples.en: We could see the outline of the mountains.
examples.zh: 我们能看到群山的轮廓。

examples.en: There is much speculation about who will win.
examples.zh: 关于谁会获胜，有很多猜测。

examples.en: A ray of sunlight came through the window.
examples.zh: 一缕阳光透过窗户照了进来。

examples.en: Scientists hope to uncover the cause of the disease.
examples.zh: 科学家们希望揭开这种疾病的成因。

examples.en: The teacher takes attendance at the start of class.
examples.zh: 老师在上课开始时点名考勤。

examples.en: She spoke on behalf of the whole class.
examples.zh: 她代表全班发言。

examples.en: The school uses an innovative way to teach English.
examples.zh: 这所学校用一种创新的方法来教英语。
